mentions.name: Isogen
mentions.description: A desktop application AI coding tool written in Rust and JavaScript, positioned as a performant, low-memory alternative to Cursor and Windsurf that stays fast enough to use while watching a video or browsing the web.
mentions.problem: Cursor, Windsurf and similar AI coding tools use too much memory and are not performant enough on the author's machine.
mentions.audience: As an engineer it is important that the tools I use daily are performant and fast
mentions.source_excerpt: An AI coding tool desktop application written in Rust and Javascript. Cursor, Windsurf and etc uses too much memory on my machine. As an engineer it is important that the tools I use daily are performant and fast and I could use while watching a youtube video or browse hackernews.
